Strawberry Matcha Chia Pudding Recipe [Paleo, Keto, Vegan]
By: Paleo Flourish
Published: Friday, August 3, 2018 - 10:22am

Ingredients




1/2 teaspoon (2 g) matcha powder
3/4 cup (175 ml) coconut milk
1.5 Tablespoons (15 g) chia seeds
2 strawberries, diced small
Stevia or raw honey to taste (optional)

Preparation

1 Place the coconut milk, matcha powder, chia seeds, and sweeteners (if you’re using any) into a cup with a lid. Shake well for 5-10 seconds. 2 Pour mixture into a glass and place into fridge for 4 hours. 3 Mix the diced strawberries into the pudding and serve – reserve 1 teaspoon of diced strawberries for topping.

About

DESCRIPTION: With just 4 simple ingredients, this delicious chia pudding will have you asking for more.
